cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. In November 2026 electronic birth notification had been piloted in Nairobi and Bomet counties, with nationwide rollout to follow.
cells.note: The birth e-service recorded nearly 300,000 births by October 2026, but in November 2026 electronic notification had only been piloted in two counties, with nationwide rollout to follow. National digital birth registration is not shown, so it stays at 2.
